text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Indahpura) 2011.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 8 Disember 2011.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Indahpura

yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Jambatan dan Lebuh Raya Laluan Kedua

Malaysia-Singapura, Lebuh Raya Laluan Pontian dan Lebuh Raya Perling yang bermula

dari kilometer 30.3 (di koordinat U-48857.985, T+6820.398 Grid Cassini Malaysia) dan

berakhir di kilometer 32.2 Persimpangan Bertingkat Indahpura (di koordinat U47389.172, T+8011.852 Grid Cassini Malaysia) yang kedua-dua jarak diukur ke arah

utara dari sempadan antarabangsa Malaysia dan Singapura, termasuk jalan-jalan

sambungannya, diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

 (2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah subperenggan

(1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (INDAHPURA INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Johor, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Indahpura Interchange)

Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 8 December 2011.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the Indahpura Interchange which is part of

the Malaysia-Singapore Second Crossing Bridge and Expressway, Pontian Link

Expressway and Perling Expressway commencing from kilometre 30.3 (at coordinates

N-48857.985, E+6820.398 of the Malaysia Cassini Grid) and ending at kilometre 32.2

Indahpura Interchange (at coordinates N-47389.172, E+8011.852 of the Malaysia

Cassini Grid) both distances as measured in a northerly direction from the

international boundary of Malaysia and Singapore, including its link roads, is declared

to be a Federal road.

 (2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
